XSS Test: Script Tag Injection

This page contains selectable text with an embedded script tag. If the extension is vulnerable to XSS, selecting this text and using Aletheia would execute the script.

Select this text: <script>alert('XSS-SCRIPT')</script> and then this text.

Note: The script tag above is HTML-escaped and does not execute. This tests whether the extension properly handles text that looks like XSS.

Expected Behavior:
  • No alert dialog should appear
  • The text should be sanitized before display
  • The overlay should show the text safely (escaped or stripped)
